sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000089-P1, was presented by GSK PHARM (the Supplier) to Summit Wellness Center 089 on July 10, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Shingles share floor of 65%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
